grammar.pattern: V得 + 程度：歌词中再用
grammar.purpose: Retrieve degree in an imagined scene
grammar.explanation: 唱得慢 describes delivery; 哭得很伤心 describes an acted or imagined emotional degree. A lyrical speaker need not be the writer. Distinguish imagery, performance and actual biography.

examples.py: jué sè kū de hěn shāng xīn .
zhè yī jù dú de hěn qīng chǔ .

commonMistakes.wrong: 歌词里的角色哭，作者一定在哭。
commonMistakes.right: 歌词里的角色不一定是作者。
commonMistakes.why: Do not infer biography from a lyrical speaker.

grammar.explanation: 比起昨天，这一句更清楚 compares the specific sentence and times. 比起快，她更重视准确 compares priorities, not a universal speed rule. Name a comparison basis and preserve the claim’s scope.

examples.zh: 比起昨天，这一句更清楚。
examples.py: bǐ qǐ zuó tiān , zhè yī jù gèng qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Compared with yesterday, this sentence is clearer.

examples.py: bǐ qǐ kuài , tā gèng zhòng shì zhǔn què .
examples.en: She values accuracy more than speed.

examples.zh: 比起独自练，她更喜欢一起读。
examples.py: bǐ qǐ dú zì liàn , tā gèng xǐ huān yì qǐ dú .
examples.en: She prefers reading together to practising alone.

commonMistakes.wrong: 这句更清楚说明全部都懂了。
commonMistakes.right: 这句更清楚没有说明全部都懂。
commonMistakes.why: A comparative clarity claim is not total mastery.

lines.zh: 你把这两段合起来试试，别一到最后就停。
lines.py: nǐ bǎ zhè liǎng duàn hé qǐ lái shì shì , bié yī dào zuì hòu jiù tíng .
lines.en: Try joining these two parts. Don't stop as soon as you reach the end.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我一快就乱，字都唱不清楚了。
lines.py: wǒ yī kuài jiù luàn , zì dōu chàng bù qīng chǔ le .
lines.en: When I speed up I get muddled. You can't make out the words.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那就慢一点。比起快，我更想听清你在唱什么。
lines.py: nà jiù màn yī diǎn . bǐ qǐ kuài , wǒ gèng xiǎng tīng qīng nǐ zài chàng shén me .
lines.en: Then slow down. I'd rather understand what you're singing than hear you go fast.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这首歌明明很安静，我怎么唱得像在吵架？
lines.py: zhè shǒu gē míng míng hěn ān jìng , wǒ zěn me chàng de xiàng zài chǎo jià ?
lines.en: This song is so quiet. Why do I sound like I'm arguing?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你太用力了。先读一遍，再跟着节拍唱。
lines.py: nǐ tài yòng lì le . xiān dú yī biàn , zài gēn zhe jié pāi chàng .
lines.en: You're pushing too hard. Read it once first, then sing with the beat.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。你别笑啊，我再来一次。
lines.py: hǎo . nǐ bié xiào a , wǒ zài lái yī cì .
lines.en: Okay. Don't laugh! I'll give it another try.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Read the words and the image
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Follow what happened and explain the people’s choices from the text.

lines.zh: 我们语言社团周五晚上练一首自己写的歌。谁也不是专业歌手，唱错了就再来。
lines.py: wǒ men yǔ yán shè tuán zhōu wǔ wǎn shang liàn yī shǒu zì jǐ xiě de gē . shéi yě bù shì zhuān yè gē shǒu , chàng cuò le jiù zài lái .
lines.en: Our language club practises a song we wrote ourselves on Friday evenings. None of us is a professional singer; when we make a mistake, we try again.

lines.zh: 我管材料，把歌词按顺序排好。朋友拿着吉他，用简单的节拍带动大家。
lines.py: wǒ guǎn cái liào , bǎ gē cí àn shùn xù pái hǎo . péng you ná zhe jí tā , yòng jiǎn dān de jié pāi dài dòng dà jiā .
lines.en: I'm in charge of the materials and put the lyrics in order. A friend plays guitar and gets everyone going with a simple beat.

lines.zh: 第一段讲一个人划船回家，第二段写他追着岸边的灯光。最后，他终于看见家门。
lines.py: dì yī duàn jiǎng yī gè rén huá chuán huí jiā , dì èr duàn xiě tā zhuī zhe àn biān de dēng guāng . zuì hòu , tā zhōng yú kàn jiàn jiā mén .
lines.en: The first verse is about someone rowing home; the second follows him chasing the lights on shore. At the end he finally sees his front door.

lines.zh: 唱到这里，我总想唱快一点。朋友说别急，这个人走了很远，现在才到家。
lines.py: chàng dào zhè lǐ , wǒ zǒng xiǎng chàng kuài yī diǎn . péng you shuō bié jí , zhè gè rén zǒu le hěn yuǎn , xiàn zài cái dào jiā .
lines.en: At this point I always want to sing faster. My friend says not to rush: he's travelled a long way and has only just got home.

lines.zh: 我重新读了一遍，慢慢唱。字清楚了，大家也更容易跟上。
lines.py: wǒ chóng xīn dú le yī biàn , màn màn chàng . zì qīng chǔ le , dà jiā yě gèng róng yì gēn shàng .
lines.en: I read it again and sang slowly. The words were clearer, and everyone found it easier to join in.

lines.en: Smoke in the distance hid the mountain.

lines.zh: 直到晚上，他才回复我。
lines.py: zhí dào wǎn shang , tā cái huí fù wǒ .
lines.en: He didn't reply until evening.

lines.zh: 我一直等到下课，直到她走出来。
lines.py: wǒ yì zhí děng dào xià kè , zhí dào tā zǒu chū lái .
lines.en: I waited until class ended and she came out.

lines.zh: 雨终于停止了。
lines.py: yǔ zhōng yú tíng zhǐ le .
lines.en: The rain finally stopped.

lines.zh: 音乐停止以后，大家都坐下了。
lines.py: yīn yuè tíng zhǐ yǐ hòu , dà jiā dōu zuò xià le .
lines.en: Everyone sat down after the music stopped.

lines.zh: 你随我来，我带你去看看。
lines.py: nǐ suí wǒ lái , wǒ dài nǐ qù kàn kàn .
lines.en: Come with me; I'll show you.

lines.zh: 他随老师一起进了教室。
lines.py: tā suí lǎo shī yì qǐ jìn le jiào shì .
lines.en: He entered the classroom with the teacher.

lines.zh: 我跑了两步，才追上她。
lines.py: wǒ pǎo le liǎng bù , cái zhuī shàng tā .
lines.en: I had to run a few steps to catch up with her.

lines.zh: 小狗追着球跑。
lines.py: xiǎo gǒu zhuī zhe qiú pǎo .
lines.en: The puppy ran after the ball.

lines.zh: 他们争着要帮老师拿东西。
lines.py: tā men zhēng zhe yào bāng lǎo shī ná dōng xi .
lines.en: They eagerly offered to carry things for the teacher.

lines.zh: 两个人都想争第一。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén dōu xiǎng zhēng dì yī .
lines.en: Both want to compete for first place.

lines.zh: 我想争取一次上场的机会。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhēng qǔ yī cì shàng chǎng de jī huì .
lines.en: I'd like to earn a chance to play.

lines.zh: 我们争取明天把事情做完。
lines.py: wǒ men zhēng qǔ míng tiān bǎ shì qíng zuò wán .
lines.en: We'll try to finish it tomorrow.

lines.zh: 这个玩具是弟弟的。
lines.py: zhè gè wán jù shì dì di de .
lines.en: This toy belongs to my younger brother.

lines.zh: 她把旧玩具送给了邻居家的孩子。
lines.py: tā bǎ jiù wán jù sòng gěi le lín jū jiā de hái zi .
lines.en: She gave her old toys to the neighbour's child.
